title: Quantum-Inspired Computational Fluid Dynamics for Transient Turbulent Compressible Flows
summary: Quantum-inspired algorithms are an emerging class of algorithms for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) with potentially favourable scaling for large problems compared to classical methods. However, their applications have been limited to incompressible flows due to arithmetic limitations, which are addressed in this work.
